name: B10-0289/2025 (S&D) – Media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Georgian journalist Mzia Amaglobeli, who was arrested in January 2025 and held for over four months. It says she was treated badly and went on a 38-day hunger strike. The Parliament asks Georgia to drop the charges against her, stop harassing journalists, and repeal laws it says limit free speech. It also says these laws could block Georgia from joining the EU. This is an opinion; the text does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks Georgia to free Amaglobeli and drop the charges.
- **Who it affects:** Georgian journalists, media groups and civil society, plus Georgia's EU membership path.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to EU institutions and Georgian authorities; the EU is asked to watch the case.
